description: PCAF Part A Option 3 sector-average emission intensities per unit of borrower revenue, by sector of the vocabulary in sectors.json, with the asset turnover ratio Option 3c needs. Option 3b's per-assets factor is derived: GHG per revenue × revenue per assets (Annex Table 10.1-2).
unit: tCO2e per million LKR of revenue
reference: Global multi-regional EEIO ranges (EXIOBASE v3.8 order of magnitude), converted to LKR at an indicative rate; see each row's gap.

rules.currency: A factor held in this currency is never applied to an exposure in another. The resolver reports it absent with the reason.
rules.vintage: Box 6.1-5 (p.167) recommends inflating score 4 and 5 factors to the reporting year. A factor applied without a deflator beyond the stated age raises FACTOR_VINTAGE_STALE.
rules.scope3: Scope 3 is estimated from this table only where the exposure asks for it. EEIO scope 3 boundaries differ from reported ones; mixing them mixes scope coverage (§5.2, pp.64–65).

agriculture.gap: Order-of-magnitude figure derived from published global EEIO ranges converted at an indicative 300 LKR per USD; not a licensed EXIOBASE extraction and not a Sri Lankan measurement. Stands in until a released factor set replaces it.
